text_en: So, have you won your key to the city yet?
Looks like that lad Melian is learning from you. Lately he hasn't stopped bouncing around the city.
I was less nervous when we were being rocked by earthquakes.
At least try to make sure he doesn't break anything. That lad seems a bit fragile for soldier, but I 'spose he shows his brave side when he has to.
